text: Mitochondrial inner membrane encloses .

text: Smooth endoplasmic reticulum .

has ribosomes attached to its surface

is actively involved in protein synthesis
solution: Correct Answer: Option (C) - is the major site for the synthesis of lipids. Smooth endoplasmic reticulum (SER) is devoid of ribosomes and is the major cellular site for the synthesis of lipids, phospholipids, and steroid hormones.

text: Which of the following are characteristics of prokaryotic cells? (a) Ribosomes are made of 50 S and 30 S subunits (b) They can have plasmids (c) They contain mesosome (d) They have peroxisomes Choose the correct answer from the options given below :
solution: Correct Answer: Option (A) - (a), (b) and (c) only. In prokaryotic cells, 70S ribosomes consist of 50S and 30S subunits (a), small circular extra-chromosomal DNA called plasmids are present (b), and specialized membranous infoldings called mesosomes are present (c). Peroxisomes are membrane-bound eukaryotic organelles.
